evidence.evidence_text: Due to the continuous emergence of new data, version updates have become an indispensable requirement for Large Language Models (LLMs).

To investigate the underlying reasons for this phenomenon, we analyze the effect of learning rate adjustments during the two stages of CPT: preparing an initialization checkpoint and continual pre-training based on this checkpoint.
